text: {"name": "rf_apply_frame_channel_settings", "confidence": "medium", "docstring": "Looks up a frame descriptor's channel/band index in a RF configuration table and applies the entry's RF/PLL settings when that entry's active flag is set.", "subsystem": "rf", "var_renames": {"result": "rfd", "v1": "rf_channel_cfg"}, "struct_hints": [{"offset": 29, "meaning": "frame descriptor channel/band index used to select RF table entry"}, {"offset": 52, "meaning": "frame descriptor PHY metric, possibly RSSI/signal/noise field"}, {"offset": 48, "meaning": "frame descriptor PHY field used as offset with byte at +52"}, {"offset": 72, "meaning": "frame descriptor integer field used in RF parameter calculation"}, {"offset": 80, "meaning": "RF config entry field containing settings pointer passed to check_radio_flag_2"}, {"offset": 96, "meaning": "RF config entry active/calibration flag"}]}
